unit: percentile of the field's own monthly root-zone wetness (NASA POWER GWETROOT), all years of the record
appliesTo: drought check for every crop in its sensitive months; a month below this percentile counts as drought
sourceLocator: table 'Percentile Range for Most Indicators': D1 Moderate Drought = 10.01 to 20.00

sourceTitle: NASA POWER parameter dictionary (community AG, monthly)
sourceLocator: GWETROOT 'Root Zone Soil Wetness': proportion of water in the upper 1 m of soil, 0 dry to 1 saturated

appliesTo: heat check against each crop's own threshold in data/crops
sourceTitle: NASA POWER parameter dictionary (community AG, monthly)
sourceLocator: T2M_MAX 'Temperature at 2 Meters Maximum': maximum hourly air temperature in the period

unit: NASA POWER parameter id, days per month
appliesTo: frost check against each crop's own threshold in data/crops
sourceTitle: NASA POWER parameter dictionary (community AG, monthly)
sourceLocator: FROST_DAYS 'Frost Days': 2 m temperature cools to the dew point and both are below 0 °C

appliesTo: calendar strip: a month cell gets a hazard mark when the crop in the ground is sensitive and the hazard occurred in more than this share of years
sourceLocator: SPEC section 8, calendar strip; value set by the team, shown on screen as a rule of thumb

unit: GAEZ v4 crop suitability index (SI), scale 0-100; the check is "at or below"
appliesTo: crops with SI at or below this value at the field (classes 'Very marginal', 'Not suitable', 'No cultivation') are excluded before scoring; the id keeps 'Below' because the engine reads it
sourceTitle: FAO GAEZ v4 res05 ImageServer legend, renderer 'Crop Suitability Index in Classes - All Land in Grid Cell'
sourceLocator: legend classes: 'SI > 10 : Marginal', 'SI > 0 : Very marginal', 'Not suitable'; SPEC section 7 excludes below 'Marginal'

unit: lower SI bound per GAEZ class, scale 0-100, exclusive ('SI > bound'); notSuitable means SI = 0. Labels: veryHigh 'Very high', high 'High', good 'Good', medium 'Medium', moderate 'Moderate', marginal 'Marginal', veryMarginal 'Very marginal', notSuitable 'Not suitable'
appliesTo: labels for GAEZ suitability on cards and in gaps
sourceTitle: FAO GAEZ v4 res05 ImageServer legend, renderer 'Crop Suitability Index in Classes - All Land in Grid Cell'

unit: °C, monthly maximum of hourly 2 m air temperature (NASA POWER T2M_MAX); a month above this counts as a heat month
appliesTo: field summary and calendar for months without a crop-specific threshold; crops in data/crops carry their own thresholds, which win
sourceLocator: D26: one crop-independent value, team rule of thumb. Matches the crop thresholds already sourced in data/crops (maize, soybean, potato 35 °C; winter wheat 34 °C)

unit: frost days per month (NASA POWER FROST_DAYS); a month with more than this counts as a frost month
appliesTo: field summary and calendar for months without a crop-specific threshold; crops in data/crops carry their own thresholds, which win
sourceLocator: D26 and #79 item 7: one crop-independent value, team rule of thumb. 0 marked every April in Iowa as a frost month (NASA POWER, Ames 1981-2025: April has frost days in 45 of 45 years). More than 10 frost days (a third of the month) separates frosty springs: April in 14 of 45 years at Ames and 6 of 45 at the Poznań field; March stays a frost month in most years at both. Crop rows in data/crops keep their own stage limits (R10), which win
